filing.subject: Bajaj Finance Limited has informed the Exchange about General Updates
filing.nse_summary: Bajaj Finance Limited submitted its Half Yearly Report for FY2026-27 for the period ended 30 September 2026. Consolidated profit after tax increased by 28% to 12,447 crore. Assets under management grew 26% to 584,624 crore. Net total income rose 23% to 31,198 crore. Profit before tax increased 29% to 16,686 crore. Gross NPA stood at 1.06% and Net NPA at 0.42%. On 1 October 2026, the Board approved raising up to 11,700 crore via Qualified Institutions Placement and up to 5,800 crore through preferential issue of warrants. The report is circulated to members and debenture holders electronically and available on the company website.

filing.subject: Tata Steel Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026.
filing.nse_summary: Tata Steel Limited approved its audited standalone and unaudited consolidated financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The statutory auditor issued a qualified opinion due to non-recognition of further fair value reduction for Tata Steel Nederland B.V., which has a carrying value of Rs. 59,078.13 crore. The auditor also highlighted an emphasis of matter regarding the Scheme of Amalgamation with Rujuvalika Investments Limited, approved by the National Company Law Tribunal on October 1, 2026. Mr. Noel Naval Tata, DIN 00024713, will retire as Non-Executive, Non-Independent Director and Vice Chairman effective November 11, 2026. The Board meeting was held on November 7, 2026.

filing.subject: Tata Steel Limited has informed the Exchange about acquisition of 38,222 equity shares of face value ₹10/- each in Creative Port Development Private Limited ( CPDPL ) due to conversion of 25,10,830 Optionally Convertible Redeemable Preference Shares of CPDPL, as per terms of issue
filing.nse_summary: Tata Steel Limited acquired 38,222 equity shares in Creative Port Development Private Limited on November 7, 2026. This acquisition resulted from the conversion of 25,10,830 Optionally Convertible Redeemable Preference Shares. The conversion ratio was one equity share for every 65.69 preference shares. Tata Steel’s equity stake in the subsidiary increased from 51% to 57.5%. The company received a cash payment of ₹6,876.11 for fractional entitlements. Creative Port Development Private Limited remains a subsidiary of Tata Steel. The target entity operates in the transportation and storage sector. No governmental or regulatory approvals were required for this transaction.

filing.nse_summary: CG Power and Industrial Solutions Limited discloses that the Hon'ble High Court Aurangabad Bench stayed the Maharashtra Pollution Control Board direction dated 3rd November 2026 ordering the closure of its manufacturing unit at Plot no. filing.subject: Zydus Lifesciences Limited has informed the Exchange about Transcript
filing.nse_summary: Zydus Lifesciences Limited filed the transcript of its Q2 FY27 post results earnings call held on November 4, 2026. The company reported consolidated revenues of ₹79.1 billion, up 29% year-on-year. EBITDA stood at ₹18.9 billion with a margin of 24%. Net profit was ₹9.3 billion. The net debt to EBITDA ratio was 0.62 times as on September 30, 2026. India branded formulations grew 19% year-on-year. International markets formulations revenues were ₹10 billion, up 33% year-on-year. US revenues reached ₹33.1 billion, up 21% year-on-year. Consumer wellness revenues were ₹11.2 billion, up 76% year-on-year. Medical devices revenues were ₹2.2 billion. The company received USFDA acceptance for the BLA for a Keytruda biosimilar. Phase IIb trial results for Saroglitazar in MASH were positive. The company is investing in the US launch of Saroglitazar.
